dedupe_keys.name: lebanon ministry of agriculture weekly wholesale and retail prices of plant and animal products and annual agricultural statistics

description: Lebanon's Ministry of Agriculture publishes two sets of figures relevant to food supply on its statistics pages. The first is a series of weekly price lists for fruit and vegetables in the country's wholesale markets and for poultry in retail markets; the most recent lists when read were dated May 2020, from the start of the economic crisis and the COVID-19 lockdown. The second is the annual agricultural statistics from a sample survey of farmers, estimating cultivated areas, numbers of livestock, poultry and bee hives, and the quantity and value of crop and animal production, with reports for 2006-2007 and 2008-2009; the 2010 comprehensive agricultural census is listed alongside. All files are free to read or download from the ministry website. Caveats: publication appears to have stopped in 2020 for prices and 2009 for annual statistics, the pages are in Arabic, and no licence is stated. Coverage is national. Simulation uses: historical wholesale price behaviour during Lebanon's 2019-2020 crisis for food supply shock studies, and baseline domestic production shares.
